about.title: Hi, I’m Ilya. Let’s meet.
about.p1: You can describe your project in everyday language. Tell me how your business works, what gets in the way and what you want to achieve. I’ll suggest how a website or application could help.
about.p2: I lead the project myself: planning the structure, designing the pages and writing the code. I share progress and explain my decisions. When other specialists are needed, I bring them in and stay your point of contact.

hero.title: I turn business problems into clear digital products.
hero.lead: Strategy, design and development stay connected from the first question to the final release.
hero.note: Some of my product work is confidential. I can still explain my role, decisions and process without breaking an NDA.

positioning.title: One person who understands the whole product.
positioning.lead: A website works better when its message, interface and code are shaped around the same goal.
positioning.body: I work across strategy, structure, visual design and frontend development. That gives you one accountable partner, fewer handovers and decisions that make sense both for the business and for the people using the product.
positioning.statement: Make the complex clear, then build it properly.

principles.title: What guides every decision.
principles.lead: Good work is not defined by decoration or technical complexity. It is defined by what the product helps someone understand and do.

clarity.title: Clarity before polish
clarity.body: The offer, hierarchy and next step need to be understandable before visual detail can make them stronger.

purpose.title: Every element earns its place
purpose.body: A section, interaction or animation stays only when it supports comprehension, trust or action.

ownership.title: Personal ownership
ownership.body: I stay close to the work, explain trade-offs clearly and remain responsible for how the pieces fit together.

longevity.title: Built beyond launch
longevity.body: The result should be maintainable, adaptable and useful after the first campaign or release is over.

capabilities.title: From the first idea to a working product.
capabilities.lead: The scope can be a focused marketing page or a custom application with real business logic.

strategy.title: Strategy & structure
strategy.body: Clarifying the audience, offer, priorities and customer path before deciding what the interface should contain.

design.title: Product & web design
design.body: Creating a visual system and responsive experience that make the message easier to understand and trust.

frontend.title: Frontend development
frontend.body: Turning the design into a fast, accessible interface with considered motion and reliable behaviour across screens.

customApps.title: Custom applications
customApps.body: Building products with accounts, data, integrations and workflows when a conventional website is not enough.

collaboration.title: Independent by default. Expanded when the work requires it.
collaboration.lead: You always have one clear point of contact, while the delivery model follows the real needs of the project.

solo.label: Direct
solo.title: I handle focused projects personally.
solo.body: For strategy, design and frontend work, I stay hands-on from discovery through launch. Communication is direct and decisions move quickly.

network.label: Specialists
network.title: Trusted expertise joins when needed.
network.body: For deeper backend, infrastructure, desktop or growth work, I bring in trusted specialists and continue to own the overall direction.

process.title: Five steps, with room to think.
process.lead: The details change with every project, but the logic stays transparent from start to finish.

context.title: Understand the context
context.body: We define the business goal, audience, constraints and what success should look like.

direction.title: Set the direction
direction.body: I shape the offer, information structure and core experience before committing to visual detail.

build.title: Design and build
build.body: The visual system and implementation develop together, keeping ideas grounded in a responsive working product.

refine.title: Review and refine
refine.body: We test the important flows, resolve edge cases and improve the details that affect understanding and use.

launch.title: Launch and hand over
launch.body: The product goes live with the necessary access, documentation and a clear path for future changes.

finalCta.title: Let’s make the next step clear.
finalCta.lead: Tell me what you are trying to build or improve. I will come back with practical questions and an honest direction.

faq.title: Questions before we start
faq.lead: Costs, timelines and what happens after launch.

price.q: How much does a website cost?
price.a: Landing pages start from 1 500 €, business sites from 2 500 €, custom applications are quoted per project. You get a fixed price before the work starts.

time.q: How long does a project take?
time.a: A landing page usually 2–3 weeks, a business site 4–6. Applications depend on scope.

scope.q: Do you handle both design and development?
scope.a: Yes. We plan the structure, design, develop and launch the website. Any additional specialists are agreed in advance.

existing.q: Can you take over an existing project?
existing.a: Yes — a builder site, old code or work left by another developer. I review it first and say honestly whether to improve, rebuild or extend.

ownership.q: Who manages the website after launch?
ownership.a: Choose a full handover of code and access, or a support subscription with the option to take over later. After a full handover, you can return to us for changes at a client discount. Support coverage, handover terms and the discount are agreed before we start.

ads.q: Can it be used with Google or Meta Ads?
ads.a: That is how it is planned from the start: clear offer, fast load, analytics and lead events ready for traffic.

testimonials.label: Client words — reserved
testimonials.text: Real quotes appear here as clients write them — nothing invented, and no stand-in praise in the meantime.

finalCta.title: What should your website do?
finalCta.lead: Tell me about your business and the task. I’ll suggest an appropriate solution, scope and cost.

hero.title: A clear account of what happens to your data.
hero.lead: This policy explains the limited information used when you browse this website or choose to contact me.

controller.title: Ilya Kavaleuski
controller.body: I am based in Poland and act as the controller for the personal data described in this policy. You can contact me with any privacy question by email.

scope.title: Scope of this policy
scope.p1: This policy applies to ilyakav.com and to personal data you send when asking about a project or otherwise contacting me about my services.
scope.p2: External websites and services have their own privacy practices. This policy does not control what they do after you follow a link, open Telegram or load an optional third-party preview.

information.title: Information I may receive
information.p1: If you contact me by email or Telegram, I receive the details you choose to provide, such as your name, contact details, project information and the content of our conversation.
information.p2: When you submit the contact form, your name, contact details, selected project type, and brief are sent to the website server on Cloudflare and forwarded to my Telegram through a bot. The website code does not write these fields to a separate database. If sending fails, you can contact me directly or open an email draft.
information.p3: The site stores only your language and theme preferences in localStorage. Hosting and network providers may also process technical logs such as an IP address, request time, requested page, browser information and error data to deliver and protect the site.

use.title: Why information is used
use.p1: I use contact information to reply, understand a proposed project, prepare or perform an agreement, keep necessary business records, and protect or troubleshoot the website.
use.p2: Depending on the situation, the legal basis is taking steps at your request or performing a contract under Article 6(1)(b) GDPR, my legitimate interests in communication, operation and security under Article 6(1)(f), or a legal obligation under Article 6(1)(c). I do not use personal data for automated decision-making or profiling.

sharing.title: Who may process information
sharing.p1: Information may be handled by providers needed to host and deliver the site, operate email and communications, or maintain its security. If you contact me through Telegram, the service you choose also processes that communication under its own terms.
sharing.p2: I do not sell or rent personal data. I may disclose information when the law requires it, or when reasonably necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims and protect the website, its users or others.

cookies.title: Local storage and third-party content
cookies.p1: Optional analytics and marketing require your consent. Your choice, its date and version are stored in localStorage; settings are available in the footer. The Cookie Policy lists the storage used and the current status of optional services.
cookies.p2: The live desktop preview of marianaleus.com is mounted only after you explicitly select Live. Loading it connects your browser to that website and any services it uses, which may process data under their own policies. On mobile, the live site opens as an external page instead.

retention.title: How long information is kept
retention.p1: Messages and project records are kept only for as long as needed to answer you, manage a working relationship, maintain necessary business records, meet legal duties or handle possible claims. The appropriate period depends on the nature of the contact and any agreement.
retention.p2: Language and theme preferences remain in your browser until you clear site data or replace them. Technical logs are retained according to the operational and security schedules of the relevant hosting or network provider.

rights.title: Your GDPR rights
rights.p1: Where the GDPR applies, you may have the right to access, correct or erase your personal data, restrict its use, receive portable data, and object to processing based on legitimate interests. These rights can be limited where the law permits or requires continued processing.
rights.p2: You can make a request using the email above. I may need enough information to verify your identity and understand the request. You may also complain to Poland’s supervisory authority, the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO), at uodo.gov.pl.

security.title: Security
security.p1: I use reasonable technical and organisational measures appropriate to this small website and the information involved, including limiting collection and relying on established service providers.
security.p2: No website, network or communication method can be guaranteed completely secure. Please avoid sending sensitive information that is not necessary for the initial conversation.

international.title: Processing outside the EEA
international.p1: Some selected technology or communication providers may process information in countries outside the European Economic Area. Data protection rules in those countries may differ from those in Poland.
international.p2: Where a restricted international transfer is involved, the relevant provider or I rely on an available legal safeguard, such as an adequacy decision or approved standard contractual clauses, as applicable to that service.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: This policy may be updated when the site, its providers or legal requirements change. The revised text will be published on this page with a new last-updated date.
changes.p2: If a change materially affects how information already provided is used, I will take reasonable steps to give any additional notice required by law.
